articles.title: Modi Seizes AI Summit to Assert India’s Global Ambitions After Tough Year
articles.mainIdea: Modi Seizes AI Summit to Assert India’s Global Ambitions After Tough Year
articles.summary: Bloomberg: Modi Seizes AI Summit to Assert India’s Global Ambitions After Tough Year. Two months into the new year, he’s secured major trade pacts with the European Union and the US, will host several foreign leaders in the coming weeks who want to clinch their own deals, is riding a wave of popular support following key state elections, and his top officials expect economic growth will beat the government’s own forecasts. This week, Modi will have an opportunity to showcase not only India’s global ambitions but also his own resurgence when he takes the stage at a high profile artificial intelligence summit in New Delhi. In attendance at the India AI Impact Summit will be more than a dozen heads of state, including from France and Brazil, and some of the most influential leaders in the tech world — from OpenAI’s Sam Altman to Sundar Pichai of Alphabet Inc. to Anthropic PBC’s Dario Amodei. Related tickers mentioned: ANTH.PVT, GOOG, INFY, MSFT, OPAI.PVT, TCS.BO.
